title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-6e8cb25fe415b983a717abdf
behavioral_concerns: follow up: QA issues limit lacks range/bounds validation allowing 0, negative, or very large limits to bypass bounded JSON and truncated metadata contract

evidence.summary: qa_handlers.go handleSprintQAIssues parses limit with Atoi only, no <1 or >200 check, forwards 0/negative/large to QAIssues
App layer QAIssues validates limit 1-200 and defaults 0->50 at sprint_usecases.go:839-844, but error is fmt.Errorf mapped to 500 internal_error via handleQueryError
Peer handlers enforce bounded limits at web layer: timeline 1-50 and runs 1-200 with 400 invalid_limit
dispatch allowsQuery excludes api_sprint_qa_issues and handler lacks onlyQueryKeys, unlike timeline/run handlers
No QA limit tests exist; qa_handlers_test.go covers QA map/shard/theory/synthesis bounded JSON but not QAIssues limit edge cases

theories.claim: dispatch allowlist inconsistency for QA issues queries leaves unknown-param contract unenforced and obscures limit validation path
theories.basis: handlers.go:422 dispatch permits RawQuery only for api_validations/api_runs/api_run_events/runs/api_timeline; api_sprint_qa_issues is not listed yet qa_handlers.go expects ?limit & ?cursor. This means either every query is rejected as 400 invalid_request unknown query parameters before limit validation, or the bypass relies on app layer, both diverging from timeline_handlers.go:55 and run_handlers.go:255 which use onlyQueryKeys. The handler also lacks unknown-param check, so ?limit=50&evil=1 would be silently accepted while dispatch blanket rule would otherwise reject it.
theories.verification_surface: static read of internal/web/handlers.go dispatch, internal/web/routes.go matchRoute for api_sprint_qa_issues, and comparative onlyQueryKeys usage in timeline_handlers.go/run_handlers.go
theories.confirmation_condition: dispatch allowlist excludes api_sprint_qa_issues and handler lacks onlyQueryKeys, creating divergent unknown-param vs limit handling compared to validated timeline/runs paths
theories.refutation_condition: dispatch includes api_sprint_qa_issues in allowsQuery or handler validates onlyQueryKeys and returns consistent 400 for unknown params
theories.inconclusive_condition: cannot execute live request to confirm whether RawQuery rejection preempts handler limit parsing
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read dispatch code, route table, and onlyQueryKeys patterns; no execution

theories.claim: handleSprintQAIssues does not validate limit bounds at the web layer, allowing 0, negative, or very large limits to reach the app layer and bypass the bounded JSON / truncated metadata contract
theories.basis: qa_handlers.go:51-66 parses limit with strconv.Atoi only and forwards Limit directly without range check or onlyQueryKeys guard. Peer handlers timeline_handlers.go:73-80 (1-50) and run_handlers.go:259-266 (1-200) validate at the handler and return 400 invalid_limit. App layer sprint_usecases.go:839-844 validates 1-200 and defaults 0->50, but its error is a plain fmt.Errorf that handleQueryError maps to 500 internal_error rather than 400 invalid_request, breaking contract-observability stable error codes and contract-performance bounded response. Dispatch handlers.go:422 allowlist does not include api_sprint_qa_issues so RawQuery handling is inconsistent with limit/cursor expectation.
theories.verification_surface: static read-only inspection of context_paths: internal/web/qa_handlers.go, internal/web/handlers.go dispatch, internal/app/sprint_usecases.go QAIssues, and comparative reads of internal/web/timeline_handlers.go and internal/web/run_handlers.go; grep for limit validation patterns
theories.confirmation_condition: qa_handlers.go limit parsing lacks any <1 or >200 guard and no onlyQueryKeys/unknown-param rejection, while peer handlers enforce bounded 400 responses and app validation for QAIssues exists but surfaces as 500
theories.refutation_condition: handler returns 400 invalid_limit/invalid_request for limit 0, limit -1, limit 201/1000000 with truncated collection metadata, or app validation is correctly projected as 400 via writeError/QA error code
theories.inconclusive_condition: live HTTP execution is prohibited read-only; cannot observe runtime status codes or response metadata truncation without executing a handler or test harness
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read-only file reads and regex grep for limit handling; compare qa_handlers.go against validated endpoints (timeline, runs); inspect dispatch allowlist and error projection in handlers.go without invoking shell, network, or mutations
